declared_exclusions.item: the 109 UNRESOLVED-PREFIX edges are not resolved, only surfaced
declared_exclusions.reason: OUT OF SCOPE BY DESIGN AND NAMED SO IT IS NOT DISCOVERED LATER. A dynamic Prefix= (f-string, concatenation, parameter, caller-supplied value) cannot be resolved by static extraction; the TO's own spec says to print an UNRESOLVED-PREFIX row and calls the trace a bonus. Resolving them would need dataflow analysis and is a separate act with its own owner. RULE 24(iv): these are the values that DO NOT MOVE on this build, and 58 scripts have ONLY unresolved prefixes, so their io read-set is unchanged -- they gain a loud row, not an edge.

declared_exclusions.item: prefix reads in non-gold code (Lambdas, silver/bronze scripts, portal)
declared_exclusions.reason: The TO scopes the census to 'gold scripts across all trees' and CP-1 to a gold script. pipeline_cli.py's separate Lambda-path analyzer already has its own s3_prefix_reads handling; I did not touch it. The 356-file denominator is gold-only and says so on its face.

declared_exclusions.item: the pre-existing _extract_module_s3_constants file-key regex is left un-anchored
declared_exclusions.reason: It carries the same latent truncation shape I fixed in my own prefix regex, but it is PRE-EXISTING machinery outside this TO's spec, and its required file-extension terminator makes the truncation far harder to reach. Surfaced as an OBSERVATION rather than fixed, because a mid-round off-spec edit to a shared extractor is exactly what the frozen-spec rule prohibits.

surprises: OBSERVATION -- the TO frames the defect as 'io enumerates KEY reads and is blind to PREFIX reads'. That framing is incomplete: SOME prefix reads were always visible (POSITIONS_CUBE_PREFIX resolves at HEAD via s3_layout). The real discriminator is WHERE THE CONSTANT IS DEFINED, not that it is a prefix -- a locally-defined KEY read is equally invisible. Three independent causes, each sufficient alone. Fixing the one I first hypothesised (the 'if not imported_names' gate) would have left the target read invisible while resolving two unrelated silver keys, i.e. it would have READ AS SUCCESSFUL. Falsified by exercising the hypothesis before building.
